from itertools import permutations
from collections import Counter

# Infer category precedence only from the supplied examples, rather than
# importing standard English adjective order.
vocabulary = {
    "opinion": "awful silly mysterious terrible wonderful obnoxious ridiculous good nice lovely repulsive",
    "origin": "japanese american russian indonesian iranian filipino ethiopian bangladeshi turkish indian chinese brazilian german vietnamese congolese mexican pakistani",
    "size": "medium-size large huge small big tiny midsize normal-size massive little enormous",
    "color": "green crimson maroon aqua brown cyan yellow white black teal red magenta violet gray indigo blue",
    "age": "archaic ancient old-fashioned new brand-new old",
    "shape": "circular prismlike pyramidal square rectangular triangular spherical",
    "material": "paper leather iron plastic wool fiberglass glass steel wood cardboard",
    "purpose": "smoking exercise walking eating driving drinking hiking snorkeling whittling",
}
category = {
    word: name
    for name, words in vocabulary.items()
    for word in words.split()
}

# All supplied examples containing more than one adjective.
# "Car key", "flower pot", and "fire extinguisher" are compound nouns.
evidence = [
    "japanese medium-size", "american large",
    "green archaic", "crimson ancient", "circular smoking",
    "maroon archaic", "aqua archaic", "filipino medium-size",
    "cyan brand-new", "yellow brand-new", "white ancient",
    "pyramidal eating", "prismlike driving", "square drinking",
    "terrible iron", "pyramidal eating", "rectangular smoking",
    "green brand-new", "rectangular exercise", "mysterious plastic",
    "massive black exercise", "teal new", "square walking",
    "bangladeshi huge", "green ancient", "white old",
    "turkish normal-size", "triangular drinking", "obnoxious iron",
    "repulsive wool", "chinese massive", "cyan old-fashioned",
    "circular hiking", "square smoking", "indian midsize",
    "red brand-new", "german brand-new spherical", "awful iron",
    "vietnamese tiny", "terrible steel", "green new",
    "magenta brand-new", "repulsive wool", "violet ancient",
    "pyramidal walking", "silly iron", "repulsive wool",
    "gray ancient", "iranian huge", "circular snorkeling",
]

options = {
    "A": "awful leather violet ancient rectangular whittling",
    "B": "maroon old square exercise cardboard obnoxious",
    "C": "little gray old triangular driving wood wonderful",
    "D": "congolese enormous green brand-new pyramidal hiking steel terrible",
    "E": "steel terrible gray new triangular hiking small",
    "F": "wool good indigo old square hiking little mexican",
    "G": "repulsive indigo brand-new prismlike drinking enormous filipino",
    "H": "pakistani tiny cyan brand-new rectangular exercise mysterious fiberglass",
    "I": "wool teal new rectangular hiking massive ethiopian",
    "J": "iranian massive blue old spherical snorkeling",
}

def categories(text):
    return [category[word] for word in text.split()]

def precedence_pairs(sequence):
    return {
        (sequence[i], sequence[j])
        for i in range(len(sequence))
        for j in range(i + 1, len(sequence))
    }

constraints = set()
for phrase in evidence:
    constraints.update(precedence_pairs(categories(phrase)))

option_constraints = {
    letter: precedence_pairs(categories(phrase))
    for letter, phrase in options.items()
}

outcomes = Counter()
model_count = 0
for order in permutations(vocabulary):
    rank = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(order)}
    if not all(rank[a] < rank[b] for a, b in constraints):
        continue
    model_count += 1
    answer = "".join(
        letter
        for letter, pairs in option_constraints.items()
        if all(rank[a] < rank[b] for a, b in pairs)
    ) or "K"
    outcomes[answer] += 1

assert model_count > 0
assert sum(outcomes.values()) == model_count

forced = "".join(
    letter for letter in options
    if all(letter in answer for answer in outcomes)
)
possible = "".join(
    letter for letter in options
    if any(letter in answer for answer in outcomes)
)

print("Exhaustively enumerated category orders:", model_count)
print("Answer sets and model counts:", dict(sorted(outcomes.items())))
print("Choices correct in every consistent order:", forced or "(none)")
print("Choices correct in at least one consistent order:", possible or "(none)")

# A direct certificate: every adjacent category in J is explicitly constrained
# by examples, so transitivity fixes J without choosing an unconstrained order.
j_chain = categories(options["J"])
assert all(pair in constraints for pair in zip(j_chain, j_chain[1:]))
print("Forced chain for J:", " < ".join(j_chain))

if len(outcomes) > 1:
    print("The examples do not uniquely determine every other option.")
    print("Nevertheless, J is necessarily correct, so K is impossible.")

submitted = "K"
if submitted not in outcomes:
    print("Submitted:", submitted)
    print("CHECK FAIL")
elif len(outcomes) == 1:
    print("CHECK PASS")
else:
    print("UNSUPPORTED: the submitted answer is not uniquely established.")
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
